cohort: 93 postpartum mothers in a tertiary care centre in Central India who delivered vaginally or by caesarean section and consented to IUCD insertion post-delivery.
finding: Post-placental and intra-caesarean IUCD insertion had a 42.2% acceptance rate, a 3.7% expulsion rate, an 11.11% discontinuation rate, no pregnancies, and 80.2% patient satisfaction after 6 weeks.
